title: Review conditional κ = 0.003644890067940 for frontier selection (#7161)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This separate contributor review recommends **conditional κ = 0.003644890067940** for exact #7161. The gain is **0.000014831897940** over selected #7000/#7001 and **0.000000482172401** over #7156. The package includes a written proof review, the exact proposed claim and a standalone replay. It retains the five selected assumptions. The maintainer selection decision remains open.

## Task and overlap

Refines `p104-side-correction` at canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Reviews #7161 at `e3f8d39c43b07063dfc5b800f71c5d21015259e6` with #7156 at `b44944c3058d522cbff17836e16240d40d77a927` and the signed #7113 caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. It reuses the byte-pinned word and directed moment helpers from #7158. #7162 and #7163 pursue separate BIT bounds. The first commit is the existing #7161 onboarding prerequisite for the selected-replay navigation test. [Earlier contributor review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7161#issuecomment-6788299545) · [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19534677)

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-frontier-7161-application-review --install-deps
```

The registered replay and Git-free committed export passed with Python 3.12.3 and NumPy 1.26.4. They check the complete dense native endpoint, 512 exact Gaussian columns of the paid exit, all four fourth roots of the signed caller, and its full **110,519 paid / 22,427 productive** invoice and **782,129,100-unit** ordinary bill. The package verifies the funded carrier, exact precision and all nine outer savings. It reruns BIT at and below the effective saving and rejects both mutations. It also rejects omitted exit/injection, dirty COPY, wrong global phase, stage/sign errors, smaller grids and corrupted source bytes.

The full supplier replay at #7161 passed locally in 836.82 s and on GitHub. The separate historical workflow entry fails its pre-existing Makefile source pin. This review freshly replays the changed exit and exact conditional application. The selected BIT and complete supplier catalogue receipts are reused with their source pins. [Exact supplier replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42961994387/job/130331981526)
